newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MARCORP, MARHOLD DETAIL RIGHTS OFFER.
newsitem.headline: MARCORP, MARHOLD DETAIL RIGHTS OFFER.

text.p: Marlin Corp Ltd (Marcorp) and Marlin Holdings Ltd (Marhold) on Tuesday detailed the terms of rights offers, announced last week, to raise a total of approximately 195 million rand.
The companies said Marcorp shareholders would receive 74 shares at an issue price of 85 cents each for every 100 shares held in terms of its offer to raise 122 million rand.
In the case of the Marhold offer shareholders would receive 88 shares at 43 cents each to raise 74.6 million rand.

The purpose of the Marcorp offer was to enable the firm to increase its equity base to fund the acquisition of the controlling interest in Kudu Granite Holdings Ltd, the resultant offer to Kudu's minority shareholders and to reduce debt levels in Kudu, they said.
The purpose of the Marhold offer was to enable the company to follow its rights in terms of the Marcorp rights offer and to increase its shareholding in Marcorp.
Marcorp announced in December it was acquiring a controlling 56 percent stake in Kudu from Germany's Deutsche Steinindustrie AG in a deal worth 50 million rand.

The acquisition makes Marcorp one the world's largest producers of granite. The inclusion of the Kudu operations will increase production at its key Rustenburg operation from 30,000 cubic metres a year to over 80,000.
